mechanism_narrative: The level of FEDFUNDS is negatively correlated with S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher interest rates compress equity discount rates and increase risk aversion.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity risk premiums, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 0.5% is not associated with significantly negative 20-day returns (t-test p>0.05) in more than 40% of observations or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS predicts negative returns when inflation expectations (CPIAUCSL) and policy rates (FEDFUNDS) rise together, signaling aggressive monetary tightening.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) is not significantly associated with negative 20-day returns (p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer confidence regimes (RSAFS > 450000), high HOUST values indicate strong housing demand that signals robust economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In RSAFS > 450000 regime, high HOUST (above 1150) is not associated with significantly positive 20-day returns (t-test p>0.05) in >40% of observations or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% is not associated with significantly negative 20-day returns (t-test p>0.05) in >40% of observations or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE predicts negative returns when employment growth (PAYEMS) decelerates relative to unemployment (UNRATE), signaling labor market stress.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) is not significantly associated with negative 20-day returns (p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The level of INDPRO is negatively correlated with S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as declining industrial production signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The negative correlation between INDPRO and 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1200, it signals strong housing market activity that indicates resilient consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 is not associated with significantly positive 5-day returns (t-test p>0.05) in >40% of observations or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
